adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`, the sync branch (`if (APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT && userId)`) returns the raw `fetch()` `Response`. Multiple callers shown in the diff expect a provider/SDK token object or an axios-like response shape, not a `Response`: e.g. Google Calendar uses `const token = res?.data;` and then reads `token.access_token`/`token.expiry_date`, which will be `undefined` on a `Response` (no `.data`), breaking token refresh when `CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` is set. HubSpot similarly types the return as `HubspotToken` but would receive a `Response` in the sync branch, so downstream field access would fail. This is a concrete behavior break introduced by the new helper.
